card.name: Words just before 'in' + cases
card.fires_on: Nouns or adjectives that are about to be followed by 'in' plus a case or group, such as a court ruling ('opinion', 'verdict', 'decision') or a death or event ('cause of death', 'involved', 'present').

modes.label: Court rulings
modes.description: A ruling noun like opinion, verdict or decision, expecting 'in' plus a case name.

modes.label: Cause or presence in reported cases
modes.description: Words about death, cause or occurrence that are followed by 'in' plus a group of cases.
modes.example: Alcohol or a history of alcohol abuse was<< involved>> in some of the fatal and nonfatal

card.writes: It promotes 'in' (and its Chinese and Arabic equivalents) and suppresses 'case' words, so it pushes toward 'in' rather than naming the case.
